mapper.select: select u.id, u.account_name as accountName, u.preferred_locale as preferredLocale, u.status, coalesce(p.staff_contact_enabled, 1) as staffContactEnabled, coalesce(p.service_announcements_enabled, 1) as serviceAnnouncementsEnabled from cm_users u left join cm_user_preferences p on p.user_id = u.id where u.id = #{userId} limit 1

select id, account_name as accountName, preferred_locale as preferredLocale, status from cm_users where status = 'active'
and (id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or account_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by account_name, id limit 30

select distinct p.id, coalesce((select lf.value from cm_profile_localized_fields lf where lf.profile_id = p.id and lf.field_name = 'profile_name' and lf.locale = 'zh' limit 1), p.id) as label from cm_profiles p join cm_profile_ownerships o on o.profile_id = p.id and o.status = 'active' where o.user_id = #{userId} and (p.id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or exists (select 1 from cm_profile_localized_fields lf where lf.profile_id = p.id and lf.field_name = 'profile_name' and lf.value like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')))
select distinct e.id, coalesce(lf.value, e.id) as label from cm_event_registrations r join cm_events e on e.id = r.event_id left join cm_event_localized_fields lf on lf.event_id = e.id and lf.field_name = 'title' and lf.locale = 'zh' where r.user_id = #{userId} and (e.id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or lf.value like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
select r.id, concat('私人介绍 · ', coalesce(lf.value, r.target_profile_id)) as label from cm_private_introduction_requests r left join cm_profile_localized_fields lf on lf.profile_id = r.target_profile_id and lf.field_name = 'profile_name' and lf.locale = 'zh' where r.requester_user_id = #{userId} and (r.id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or lf.value like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
select m.id, concat(m.tier, ' · ', m.status) as label from cm_user_memberships m where m.user_id = #{userId} and (m.id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or m.tier like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
select null id, null label where 1 = 0
limit 30

select id from cm_inbox_threads where user_id = #{userId} and category = 'system' and status = 'open' and ((#{subjectType} is null and subject_type is null and subject_id is null) or (subject_type = #{subjectType} and subject_id = #{subjectId})) order by updated_at desc limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into cm_inbox_threads (id, user_id, category, subject_type, subject_id, status) values (#{id}, #{userId}, 'system', #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, 'open')
mapper.update: update cm_inbox_threads set updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{threadId}
